The TypeScript package's recorded Stats answers, for the parity test of this
package (tests/test_stats_ts_answers.py).

These files are bca-mcp-ts test/fixtures/stats_api as of its commit 75e16f4
(0.9.0), copied unchanged: answers/, expected_outputs/, shards/, SHA256SUMS
and README.md. 42 of the 55 calls come from the API's dump
(scripts/dump_stats_answers.py at API commit 02e19b8, on the API's
fixtures), the 8 chain calls among them; the others are stand-ins made
before the dump existed. Their README says which is which and how the
expected outputs were made: from the design's reference rules, not from
either package's code. Every wallet and vault address is made up (0x plus
SHA-256 of a bca-fixture string), and no wallet, vault name or vault figure
is from the real files. The yield answers hold the 17 public products of the
live Yields file of 2026-11-26, moved to 2026-11-24, with their token
addresses, and four made-up products named Fixture. The chain answers hold
the public chains of the live Chains file, whose incident sources are each
chain's own pages, next to made-up chains whose ids start with fixture-chain
and one made-up upcoming chain.

This package's own set stays in tests/fixtures/stats_api.
